name: Kamitaira Rei
source:
Birth year: 2034

Main character of episode 1
A 10-year-old boy born in a secret village. Rei has always been interested in the fascinating "outside world", however, following [url=/c92641]Subaru[/url]'s order, a victory against [url=/c92646]Mikage[/url] in a one-on-one battle is required for every child who wants to explore life outside of the village.
As a result, he spends his whole childhood practicing in hope of getting stronger. But the peaceful life is broken, when Rei discovered an abandoned building in the village's dumpsite...

Main character of episode 2
The year is 2053. Rei, along with [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url], formed the "Lost History Excavation" team (abbr. URH), where they would collect information in past events, by request. And one day, they meet [url=/c92656]Misora[/url], with the request of finding [url=/c92658]her daughter[/url] and [url=/c92661]husband[/url], who have left home 4 years ago.
Note: URH stands for Ushinawareta Rekishi Hakkutsu (失われた歴史発掘) - which is roughly translated into "Lost History Excavation"
